page.layout: One page of running text in one column; marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines "ftrat" and "ftinus". Running head at the top, page number at the top left. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: ftitui confilium iftud,qui firmi in veritate funt, aut qui infirmi funt,aut qui in mendacium traducti funt. Firmorum caufa non putem: quid opus eft? Infirmorum caufa plus habet fpeciei: fed tamen poftquam ex veritate femel, aut bis fuerit diffentientibus fatisfactu; equidem magis metuero, vt infirmentur contentione infirmi,quàm fperauero fore, vt perfcriptione noua confirmentur. Et (quod grauius eft) multiplex de eodem fcriptio hoc habet incommodi,quòd plerumque filuam offenfionis infirmis atque imperitis,calumniæ verò aduerfariis fubmini-Prou.10.ftrat: quia (vt ait Sapiens) multitudine verborum non ceffat defectio. Quòd fi eorü caufam adduxeris qui iam malo errore implicantur, ftudium laudo,fed effectum non video. contrà enim plurimùm vfuuenit, vt ea ipfa mala quæ modò oftendimus,miferos confirment in malo, quemadmodum iniecta aqua fabriles carbones folent inardefcere.Hoc quotidiana docet experientia; & infignibus duobus exemplis,nimirū fuo & alterius cuiufdam Epifcopi, Augu-Lib.3.c[?]- fi[?].ca.vl- time.ftinus optimè demonftrauit,qui ex Manichæorum erroribus nō vllo humano facto,fed fingulari Dei teftimonio,tanquam ex peftilentiffima fœtorum fentina erepti funt: Omnino præftat in hoc genere mali antecedétia fcripta & documenta cōmodè & quafi aliud agendo, erranti-bus fubiicere,ad teftandâ conftantiâ noftram in doctrina veritatis, quū noua multa procudere.

page.notes: The first word "ftitui" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The marginal reference "Lib.3.c[?]- fi[?].ca.vl- time." is partly unclear. The marks at the lower left of the page (faint, "ꝝ ı ꞌ") are not clearly readable and were not transcribed as a signature. The page has no visible reference mark in the text beside the margin notes.
